summary: Extremely OK Games' precision-platformer series, including the original PICO-8 game, the 2018 full release, and official anniversary spin-offs.

entries.title: Celeste Classic

primary.why: The official itch.io page presents the original four-day PICO-8 game as a playable HTML5 release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the official browser version on itch.io with keyboard controls.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2018 Celeste is a full reimagining rather than a straight replacement; keep this classic entry distinct.

entries.title: Celeste

primary.version: Current PC release with Farewell update
primary.why: Windows has the flexible native PC route and includes the post-launch Farewell chapter content, while the other active versions have no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version through Steam, itch.io, Epic Games Store, or another PC storefront with controller or keyboard.

entries.remaster_caveats: Farewell is an update/DLC chapter to include in the main playthrough; Stadia is kept only as historical release coverage.

entries.title: Celeste Classic 2: Lani's Trek

primary.why: The official release offers Windows, macOS, Linux, and HTML5; Windows is the stable local archive route while preserving the PICO-8 design.
primary.how_to_play: Download the Windows build from the official itch.io page, or use the HTML5 version for quick access.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a small anniversary sequel to the PICO-8 original, not Celeste 2 as a large commercial sequel.

entries.title: Celeste 64: Fragments of the Mountain

primary.why: The official free anniversary spin-off released for Windows/Linux first and later macOS; Windows is the simplest high-compatibility desktop route.
primary.how_to_play: Download the current Windows build from the official itch.io page and use a controller as recommended by the developer.

entries.remaster_caveats: Short free anniversary spin-off, not a full-scale commercial sequel.
